purpose: Teach: 歓声/一節/サントラ/裏話/夜行/見栄え/新春/旅客機

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、本気で、絶対、応援の、絶対、歓声、絶対、お聞きになったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, do you remember? When you were young, your father — he really used to cheer so earnestly. You must remember that.
lines.style: Soft, reaching backward in time. Gentle curiosity on the opening. Pause before 'remember' — giving her space to recall. Warm but searching, like holding out a hand across decades.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お好きな曲の、絶対、一節、絶対、いつも歌ってらしたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. You know, your grandfather used to sing snatches of his favorite songs all the time when he was young. You remember that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright recognition breaking through. Immediate, as if the memory was waiting right there. Gentle affection in 'dear.' Unhurried — she's savoring the details as she speaks them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お映画の、絶対、サントラ、絶対、お好きだったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, when you were young — you really did love those movie soundtracks, didn't you? I remember that.
lines.style: Soft, almost conversational. Less wistful now, more intimate — like he's placing a specific memory down between them. Slight lift of certainty on 'remember.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、芸能人の、絶対、裏話、絶対、新聞、絶対、お読みになってたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes! Your grandfather used to read all those celebrity gossip columns in the newspaper when he was young. You remember, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Delighted recall. Voice brightens. A little conspiratorial — like she's enjoying the image of him. 'Dear' lands with warmth, not formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、夜行、絶対、列車、絶対、お乗りになったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, you really did take those night trains when you were young. Don't you remember? I do.
lines.style: Quieter turn. Specific memory — he's narrowing in. Slight wonder in his voice, like he's still a little amazed that she did these things. Trailing softly into the certainty.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お料理の、絶対、見栄え、絶対、こだわってらしたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: That's right. Your grandfather was so particular about how his cooking looked when he was young. You remember that about him, don't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, pleased. A small smile in the voice — an endearing detail. 'Particular' gets a little emphasis, affectionate. Ends gently, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、新春、絶対、のご挨拶、絶対、丁寧にしてくださったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, you always made such a point of offering New Year's greetings properly, didn't you? I remember that.
lines.style: Tender admiration. The word 'properly' carries respect — not criticism, but recognition. Slow, ceremonial pace, matching the formality of the memory itself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、旅客機、絶対、お乗りになるの、絶対、お好きだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, dear. Your grandfather — he really did love flying on airliners when he was young. You must remember that.
lines.style: Soft, pleased agreement. The memory lands with a smile. 'Dear' is intimate, unhurried. Slight trailing-off, as if she's watching the memory recede into the past.
